scenarios.title: Two tickets within a budget
scenarios.notes: Miniature Worlds ($41) and Blue Room Quartet ($40 when booked Thursday). Courtyard Films ($43) and Late Gallery ($42.50) exceed the budget. Print Fair starts before 7 p.m.

messages.content:
Which of these events could two of us go to this Saturday for at most $42 total? We can't arrive before 7 p.m. We can book today, which is Thursday. Here are the listings.

Courtyard Films, 7:30 p.m. — $18 each plus $3.50 per ticket.
Miniature Worlds, 8 p.m. — $19 each plus $3 per order.
Blue Room Quartet, 7 p.m. — $18 each plus a $4 per ticket weekend surcharge. Box office note: ‘For a Saturday performance, bookings placed by Friday at noon pay one $4 surcharge per order, regardless of the number of tickets.’
Late Gallery, 9 p.m. — $16 each plus a $10.50 fee per order.
Print Fair, 6:45 p.m. — $18 each with no fee.
The amounts above include all charges.
Miniature Worlds is the only option. Blue Room Quartet is $44 because the surcharge applies to each ticket.

The listings distinguish charges per ticket and per order. Blue Room's box office says ‘For a Saturday performance, bookings placed by Friday at noon pay one $4 surcharge per order, regardless of the number of tickets.’ Which events actually fit our arrival time and $42 total when we book today?

scenarios.title: Making an evening bus transfer
scenarios.notes: The same ticket covers the second bus. It is 97 minutes after a qualifying Saturday tap, within 105 minutes. The user must still tap on the second bus.

messages.content:
Can I use the same ticket on my second bus, or will I need to pay again? My first bus tap was at 6:12 p.m. on Saturday, and I need to tap on the second bus at 7:49 p.m. Neither is an airport route.

Fare guide: ‘A regular ticket includes one transfer up to 90 minutes after the first tap. Airport routes charge a separate fare.’

Customer update for Saturdays: ‘If your first tap is at or after 6 p.m. on Saturday, a regular ticket includes one transfer up to 105 minutes after the first tap. The airport route surcharge still applies. Always tap on the second bus, even when the transfer is included.’
You need to pay for the second bus. The rides are 97 minutes apart and a regular ticket allows 90 minutes for a transfer.

The Saturday update says ‘If your first tap is at or after 6 p.m. on Saturday, a regular ticket includes one transfer up to 105 minutes after the first tap.’ The first tap was at 6:12 and the next one is at 7:49. Does the same ticket cover it?
